skill.name: Molten Shield
skill.description: Grants Annie or an ally a shield, a burst of Move Speed, and damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells.

skill.name: Glacial Fissure
skill.description: Braum slams the ground, knocking up enemies nearby and in a line in front of him. A fissure is left along the line that slows enemies.

skill.name: Spiraling Despair
skill.description: Hwei paints a vision of pure despair. The first enemy champion struck becomes the center of an expanding painting that slows and damages nearby enemies. The vision explodes after reaching its maximum size or when the champion dies.

skill.name: Slicing Maelstrom
skill.description: Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions for magical damage.

skill.name: Light Binding
skill.description: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.

skill.name: Prismatic Barrier
skill.description: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.

skill.name: Darkin Daggers
skill.description:
Naafiri hurls up to two daggers, each inflicting bleed, or each inflicting bonus damage if the target is already bleeding.

Packmates leap to attack the first champion or monster hit by this skill.

skill.name: Eviscerate
skill.description: Naafiri dashes and damages enemies in an area around her, recalling her packmates and fully healing them.

skill.name: Double Daggers
skill.description: Xayah throws two damaging daggers that also drop Feathers she can recall.

skill.name: Deadly Plumage
skill.description: Xayah creates a storm of blades that increase her Attack Speed and damage while also granting her Move Speed if she attacks a champion.

skill.name: Bladecaller
skill.description: Xayah calls back all her dropped Feathers dealing damage and rooting enemies.
